findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "film" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: doseedo_generate_sound, doseedo_render_midi, doseedo_check_take, doseedo_analyze_midi, doseedo_get_upload_url, doseedo_check_task · Private data: doseedo_render_midi, doseedo_train_instrument, doseedo_render_score, doseedo_mix, doseedo_session_from_stems, doseedo_spot_video, doseedo_get_upload_url, doseedo_check_task · Public sink: doseedo_train_instrument, doseedo_mix, doseedo_score_to_picture, doseedo_check_take, doseedo_analyze_midi, doseedo_get_upload_url, doseedo_wait_task · Destructive: doseedo_generate_sound, doseedo_render_midi, doseedo_score_to_picture, doseedo_tempo_map, doseedo_get_upload_url, doseedo_cancel_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: doseedo_generate_sound, doseedo_render_midi, doseedo_check_take, doseedo_analyze_midi, doseedo_get_upload_url, doseedo_check_task · Private data: doseedo_render_midi, doseedo_train_instrument, doseedo_render_score, doseedo_mix, doseedo_session_from_stems, doseedo_spot_video, doseedo_get_upload_url, doseedo_check_task · Public sink: doseedo_train_instrument, doseedo_mix, doseedo_score_to_picture, doseedo_check_take, doseedo_analyze_midi, doseedo_get_upload_url, doseedo_wait_task · Destructive: doseedo_generate_sound, doseedo_render_midi, doseedo_score_to_picture, doseedo_tempo_map, doseedo_get_upload_url, doseedo_cancel_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
